about: webcpp::hash's capability table (spec section 3.5): which library implements each public name, over which hmacs, on which targets, what upstream states about constant time, and the backend a call that names none uses. backend_has_v is the same table for the key derivations and the families: test/capabilities_test.cpp compares them cell by cell, checks each type row against the code, each default against default_backend and each refusal text against its row. The documentation renders from it. The default rule (design D34): a key derivation of increment 1 runs on hash2, argon2id and scrypt on sodium; a tag of the families defaults to the first of hash2, xkcp, blake3 and sodium that has it fully once increments 2 to 7 have landed, else the first of them with a partial cell, else none (null: the call names its backend); bearssl, openssl, botan and webcrypto are never a default. A default never changes; one whose backend's cell lands in a later increment is written already, and its row lists it before the cell.

layout.schema: This description. The version of the layout is "version"; a change of layout raises it.
layout.backends[]: Each library a function runs on: name (as cells name it), tag (its webcpp::hash::backends type), macro (the word of WEBCPP_HASH_HAS_<macro>), library (name and pin), licence, jamfile (the target a program names), targets (where it builds).
layout.hmacs: The hmac columns of a function over an hmac: the aliases of <webcpp/hash/hmac.hpp>, and "other", hmac<H> over any other Boost.Hash2 hash whose result is a digest.
layout.algorithms[]: One row group of spec 3.5: name, macro (the algorithm's word in upper case), tag (its kdfs:: type, or null), chapter (the documentation's chapter: digests, macs, kdfs, password_hashing, non-cryptographic), standard, functions.
layout.functions[]: One public name: name (a type's or function's own name; a family's row is named by its qualified tag, as digests::sha2_256 or macs::hmac<digests::sha2_256>), kind ("type": a Boost.Hash2-form type; "function": a function template with a Backend parameter; "digest": a tag of digest_of and hasher; "mac": a tag of mac; "kdf": a variant of argon2), header, default (for a function or a family's tag, the backend default_backend names when the call names none, null for a tag with no default (detail::no_default) and for a type; a family's default may be a backend whose cell lands in a later increment), backends.
layout.backends{}: Per backend name, the cell: since (the increment it came with, 1 to 7), hmacs (the columns it has, or null for a function or type that takes no hmac), partial (only on a cell that refuses some values the family accepts: what it refuses, with unsupported_by_backend), constant_time {value: "yes", "no" or "not stated", source: where upstream says so, or what was read and says nothing}. A cell holds on every target of its backend.
